notes.title: 《缚戎人：唐建中十三年》 今日在Steam平台正式发售！
notes.content:
[h3]诸位，久等了！《缚戎人》终于和大家见面啦！[/h3][p][/p][p]历史题材AVG游戏《缚戎人：唐建中十三年》今日正式在Steam平台发售，国区售价28元，前两周享85折优惠，到手价仅23.8元。游戏总计文本25万字以上，包含10个结局，接近40张各种CG插画，可以收集近40种文物，全流程中文配音。[/p][p]Steam 商店页：[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3353620/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]游戏以中唐时期即将沦陷的西州柳中作为故事背景，讲述归义军的前传，那些在看不到丝毫希望的在战争中挣扎的被困于西域的唐军将士的故事。希望《缚戎人：唐建中十三年》能带给大家更多惊喜与感动，一起感受大唐归义军前传厚重的历史魅力！[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318630/c2cad093f866eeb1a4ba3e12b9480235e5e9ae3f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]踏入乱世，书写你的传奇[/b][/h3][p]  在这片风沙弥漫的西域边境，昔日的盛唐已走向衰落，烽火与阴谋交织，忠义与背叛同生。柳中城，这座被遗落在大漠深处的孤城，成为了唐军残部与百姓最后的庇护之地。
玩家将亲身走入这段厚重的历史：在城池将倾之际，与志同道合的将士并肩作战，抉择生死去留；在残酷的乱世中守护百姓的安宁，或踏上另一条充满未知与牺牲的道路。
这里没有轻易的胜利，只有血与泪铸就的忠魂，以及在无数可能中书写属于你的传奇结局。[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318630/eec7b1fada46bf56883b82561c3f1a5ab32748d0.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]多重结局，塑造独一无二的旅程[/b][/h3][p]  在柳中这座摇摇欲坠的孤城中，没有绝对正确的道路。每一次选择，哪怕是看似微不足道的举动，都可能改变城中局势的走向，甚至决定身边人物的生死。你将直面复杂的人性考验：是坚守忠义，还是顺应生存？是牺牲小我，还是守护至亲？无论是策略上的果断，还是情感上的抉择，都会一步步塑造出只属于你的命运篇章。在这片乱世大地上，没有两段旅程是相同的。你的每一个决定，都会在战火与历史中留下痕迹，编织出独一无二的结局，让你真切体会忠义与生存的微妙平衡，以及乱世下人性的光辉与沉沦。[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318630/1a03b0430d0acc8ef84f70cd8a4fb721620083df.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]丰富内容，深度沉浸[/b][/h3][p] 《缚戎人：唐建中十三年》不仅仅是一段旅程，更是一部充满厚度与细节的历史画卷。游戏内含超过 25 万字的剧情文本，将带你深入那个烽火四起、百姓流离的动荡年代；10 种不同结局，映照出无数命运的可能，见证忠义与背叛、希望与绝望的交错。近 40 张精美 CG，配合 全流程中文配音，让角色的情感与城池的悲欢在你眼前鲜活再现；同时，你还可以收集 近 40 种文物，一点点拼凑出被岁月与战火掩埋的历史碎片。在这里，你不仅是旁观者，更是亲历者。你的选择与行动，将一步步改写柳中城的命运，开启只属于你的乱世冒险！[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318630/bb4a4d3f30a19a7c9117ef696e5709e035ae0ffa.png"][/img][/p][p]《缚戎人：唐建中十三年》现已在Steam平台发售，各位玩家可以前往购买并且下载游戏。那段被岁月与战火掩埋的破碎历史，由你书写破损的篇章，改写柳中城的命运。[/p]

notes.title: 大唐归义军前传！《缚戎人》定档9月10日正式发售！
notes.content: [p]Hello大家好，这里是思维度工作室，这里依旧是制作人Resher！我们自去年10月开始制作的历史题材AVG游戏《缚戎人：唐建中十三年》目前已制作完成，进行了Debug测试，且已通过STEAM审核！万事具备，离游戏的上线仅差最一步了！[/p][p][/p][p]经过和团队小伙伴们的商量，[b]我们正式将游戏的上线时间确定在9月10日上午12点整[/b]，游戏的国区售价确定为28元整，前两周享85折优惠，到手价为23.8元，我们坚守众筹承诺，当时支持了我们的小伙伴的cdkry入手价格19元为最低价格！我们将自本月25号开始陆续通过爱发电平台的私信为众筹的小伙伴们发放cdkey，至最晚9月9日全部发放完毕，游戏上线后即可第一时间兑换入库！[/p][p] [/p][p]本作的体量为总计文本25万字以上，包含10个结局，接近40张各种CG插画，可以收集近40种文物，全流程中文配音的。[/p][p][/p][p]本作将以中唐时期即将沦陷的西州柳中作为故事背景，讲述归义军的前传，那些在看不到丝毫希望的在战争中挣扎的被困于西域的唐军将士的故事。[/p][p][/p][p]再次感谢那些在b站、小黑盒关注我们的小伙伴们！还有所以参与了众筹，支持了我们的小伙伴们！我们也清楚今年行业内关于游戏剧本内容、玩家交流、众筹发生了很多不好的事情，这也令我们诚惶诚恐。我们也进行了多次的自查，以尽可能确保，我们的行为和游戏内容都尽可能符合玩家期待。[/p][p][/p][p]我们在游戏上线后也会保持对玩家反馈意见，无论是剧情设计上还是程序BUG上的反馈或者批评，都一定会认真听取！我们会尽全力尽快的修复可能出现的BUG！[/p][p][/p][p]相同的，如果您对于剧情有任何意见或者不满，也欢迎您在任何公开渠道充分的表达您的看法，我们会认真接受！[/p][p][/p][p]最后我们也将在今天即8月22日发布游戏DEMO的最后一次更新！将DEMO同步至正式版的设计理念，如果您是第一次了解到我们的游戏，又有些兴趣，可以去抢先体验！[/p][p][/p][p]最后，感谢大家一直以来的包容，仅允许我代表思维度工作室向您致以最诚挚感谢！9月10上午12点不见不散！[/p]

notes.title: We Who Remain: Tang Chronicles Demo 2.0 Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,
We’re excited to announce that the Demo 2.0 version of We Who Remain: Tang Chronicles is now available on Steam! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318630/4ffd96f969cbffaf67e5eeb8c1cc400e4accd8a8.png"][/img]This update brings major improvements to visuals, story structure, system performance, and audio quality—delivering a more immersive and polished experience.
________________________________________
[/p][h3]Highlights[/h3][p]•	Historically Grounded Narrative: Built from first-hand historical sources like Dunhuang manuscripts and local inscriptions, creating a realistic and immersive Tang-era setting.
•	Distinct Art Style: Combines modern design with traditional Eastern aesthetics for a unique visual identity.
•	Integrated Relic System: Deepens the lore and offers historical insights alongside the main story.
•	Emotional, Realistic Characters: Explores complex themes like ethnic identity and moral dilemmas rather than relying on standard romance tropes.
•	Cultural Immersion: Rich with classical Chinese literature, poetry, and historical references, while also considering localization for global audiences.
•	Cross-Platform Compatibility: Supports Windows/macOS/Linux/SteamOS.
•	Multi-Branch Narrative: Choices affect the outcome significantly, encouraging exploration and replayability.
•	Hybrid Soundtrack: Blends traditional instruments from Tang-era frontier regions with modern electronic elements.
________________________________________
[/p][h3]Demo 2.0 Patch Notes[/h3][p]•	Added 3 brand-new CG illustrations
•	Polished and animated existing CGs
•	Fixed text errors and historical inaccuracies
•	Improved script pacing and structure
•	Resolved UI bug in multiline text display
•	Fixed character flickering during fast-forward
•	Optimized save system for future compatibility
•	Fully re-recorded voice for Yang Zhihong; partial re-recordings for others
•	All voice lines remixed for better clarity and volume balance
________________________________________
We hope you enjoy this upgraded demo! Your feedback is always welcome as we continue refining the full release.

Be sure to add “We Who Remain: Tang Chronicles” to your Steam wishlist so we can keep you informed!

notes.title: Exhibited at Eastern Game Fest — Crowdfunding Successfully Concluded!
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,
With great excitement and heartfelt gratitude, we are thrilled to officially announce that the crowdfunding campaign for “We Who Remain: Tang Chronicles” has been a complete success!
This victory belongs to every one of our supporters—and it’s the driving force that keeps us moving forward!
We extend our sincerest thanks to everyone who backed us, helped spread the word, or offered valuable suggestions. It is because of your support that Bound by the Barbarians has taken this crucial step toward realizing the immersive dream of a grand and chaotic Tang Dynasty.
We deeply feel your high expectations and are working hard to polish and refine the game. The full release is currently planned for August 2025!
Now, here are a few key project updates:
________________________________________
[/p][h3]1. Demo Now Available — Try it & Share Your Feedback![/h3][p]The demo version of We Who Remain: Tang Chronicles is now available for download on Steam.
While the current build is still in development, you can already experience the core gameplay and story atmosphere!
Upcoming improvements to the demo include (but are not limited to):
• New CG art assets
• Enhanced and additional voice acting
• Corrections to historical details and narrative descriptions
• Fine-tuning for overall gameplay experience
We warmly welcome your feedback via the Steam community or our QQ group. Your suggestions help us improve and grow!
________________________________________
[/p][h3]2. Crowdfunding Reward Delivery Schedule[/h3][p]Shipping details are as follows:
• ¥288 Tier Boxes: Shipping began on April 15
• ¥388 Tier Boxes: Shipping began on April 16–17
• ¥588 Tier Boxes: Shipping began on April 17–18
• ¥1124 / ¥2024 Tier Boxes: Estimated to ship before May 1
To ensure a safe and quality unboxing experience, we’ve paid close attention to packaging:
✔ All boxes use 2–3 layers of protective packaging
✔ Reinforced 5-ply, 7-layer shipping cartons—no fragile foam used
✔ Premium bubble wrap used for all items to ensure safe delivery
________________________________________
Add-On Gifts & ¥38–¥188 Tier Gifts
• Add-on items and ¥38–¥188 tier gifts will begin shipping after April 20
• We will make every effort to ship all of these items by May 1
• These will be sent using standard packaging and regular courier services—thank you for your understanding!
________________________________________
After-Sales & Shipping Info
• After-sales support for crowdfunding rewards will remain available until July
• If your reward arrives damaged or with other issues, feel free to contact us—we will assist you promptly
• Tracking numbers will be gradually uploaded to the Afdian order system and sent via private message
• If you don’t receive a notification, feel free to reach out to us directly for your tracking info
________________________________________
[/p][h3]3. Stay Connected with Us![/h3][p]Want to be the first to hear about updates and the official launch?
Be sure to add “We Who Remain: Tang Chronicles” to your Steam wishlist so we can keep you informed!
Also, don’t forget to follow our official Heybox account for ongoing limited-time events, chances to win exclusive merch, and behind-the-scenes content straight from the dev team!
